4ff7a47bfce07ba3949ce507ef73ca7b7b5d52f7.label: LifeTrac: v25
4ff7a47bfce07ba3949ce507ef73ca7b7b5d52f7.note: LifeTrac v25 (2025–26): bolted plate frame, four direct-drive hydraulic wheels, loader arms, LoRa remote control, a Power Cube for its heart

assemblies.label: Frame
assemblies.note: Two sandwiches of 1/2" plate, one each side, 120 mm apart for the arms and lift cylinders to work in, bolted to a floor plate, two 6×2 cross tubes and stiffeners with grade-8 bolts. Welding only at the arm pivots and the wheel hubs.

assemblies.label: Wheel unit, front left
assemblies.note: A Universal Wheel Unit: a 100 cc/rev hydraulic motor bolted to the motor plate, coupled straight to a 1¼" shaft in two flange bearings, a welded hub and a Bobcat wheel. No chain, no gearbox.

assemblies.label: Wheel unit, front right
assemblies.note: A Universal Wheel Unit: a 100 cc/rev hydraulic motor bolted to the motor plate, coupled straight to a 1¼" shaft in two flange bearings, a welded hub and a Bobcat wheel. No chain, no gearbox.

assemblies.label: Wheel unit, rear left
assemblies.note: A Universal Wheel Unit: a 100 cc/rev hydraulic motor bolted to the motor plate, coupled straight to a 1¼" shaft in two flange bearings, a welded hub and a Bobcat wheel. No chain, no gearbox.

assemblies.label: Wheel unit, rear right
assemblies.note: A Universal Wheel Unit: a 100 cc/rev hydraulic motor bolted to the motor plate, coupled straight to a 1¼" shaft in two flange bearings, a welded hub and a Bobcat wheel. No chain, no gearbox.

assemblies.label: Power Cube
assemblies.note: OSE’s Power Cube VII/7s, the same cube that drives the CEB press and the other machines of the Global Village Construction Set: a 28 hp V-twin on a gear pump with its own tanks, relief, cooler, filter and battery, set whole on the LifeTrac’s cradle and coupled by two hoses. (v25’s own bills build an 18 hp Vanguard unit into the frame instead.) It is its own asset and actor too: every part is the same there.

assemblies.label: Hydraulic circuit
assemblies.note: From the cube’s pressure coupler: the proportional flow valve that sets every speed, a four-station manifold of 12 V directional valves (left wheels, right wheels, arms, bucket) on top of the cube, the hoses out to every motor and cylinder, and the return line back to the cube’s cooler and filter.

assemblies.label: Loader arms
assemblies.note: Two L-shaped arms, each a 6×2 tube between two 1/4" side plates, pivoting on 1½" pins in the frame’s sandwiches and tied together by the cross beam that carries the bucket cylinders.

assemblies.label: Cylinders
assemblies.note: Four double-acting hydraulic cylinders: two 2.5" lift cylinders raise the arms, two 3" bucket cylinders curl and dump the bucket. Each is a barrel on one pin and a rod on the other.

assemblies.label: Bucket
assemblies.note: A 1,100 mm bucket of 1/4" plate with a 3/4" cutting edge, pinned at the arms’ tips and tipped by the bucket cylinders.

assemblies.label: Standing platform
assemblies.note: A folding deck at the back for an operator to ride on; folded up when the machine is driven by radio, as it is meant to be.

assemblies.label: Controller and radio
assemblies.note: The tractor node: a Portenta X8 on its Max Carrier (Linux, the LoRa radio, the arbiter) driving an Arduino Opta over Modbus, whose solid-state outputs switch the eight valve coils; a safety relay and the master switch on the Power Cube’s battery, the mast with its antennas, cameras and beacon, and the handheld it obeys.

parts.label: Outer side panel, left (P1)
parts.what: The outside wall of the left sandwich, the machine’s biggest part: cut from 1/2" A36 plate, it carries the arm’s pivot pin and the lift cylinder’s base pin on one side of the 120 mm gap, and the wheel bearings’ outer flanges.

parts.label: Outer side panel, right (P2)
parts.what: The outside wall of the right sandwich, the machine’s biggest part: cut from 1/2" A36 plate, it carries the arm’s pivot pin and the lift cylinder’s base pin on one side of the 120 mm gap, and the wheel bearings’ outer flanges.

parts.label: Inner side panel, left (P3)
parts.what: The inside wall of a sandwich: with the outer panel 120 mm away it makes the slot the loader arm and its lift cylinder swing in, so the pins are held at both ends (double shear) instead of hanging off one plate.

parts.label: Inner side panel, right (P3)
parts.what: The inside wall of a sandwich: with the outer panel 120 mm away it makes the slot the loader arm and its lift cylinder swing in, so the pins are held at both ends (double shear) instead of hanging off one plate.

parts.label: Bottom stiffener plate (P7)
parts.what: The floor of the frame and its first part: the angle runs are bolted to it, then everything stands on them. It ties the bottoms of the four side panels and the motor plates together.

parts.label: Bottom angle runs (A6)
parts.what: Six runs of 2×2×1/4 angle, three segments each, bolted along the floor plate under every panel line: the panels and motor plates stand on their vertical legs and are bolted through them.

parts.label: Back stiffener plate (P4)
parts.what: The back wall, closing the frame between the sandwiches high up behind the arm pivots: it squares the frame and carries the mast, the E-stop and the handheld’s holster. Below it the frame is open for the folding platform.

parts.label: Back wall angles (A1, A2)
parts.what: Six vertical 2×2 angles bolted to the back plate, two at its outer edges and four inside, joining it to the side panels and stiffening it.

parts.label: Front stiffener plates (P5, P6)
parts.what: Three small plates closing the front: the centre plate low between the inner panels, and an outer plate across the front of each sandwich’s gap, all bolted through eight short angles (A10).

parts.label: Motor mounting plate, left (P8)
parts.what: A 10" high plate standing 6" inboard of the inner panel the whole length of the frame: both wheel motors of its side bolt to it, their shafts passing out through the panels to the wheels.

parts.label: Motor mounting plate, right (P8)
parts.what: A 10" high plate standing 6" inboard of the inner panel the whole length of the frame: both wheel motors of its side bolt to it, their shafts passing out through the panels to the wheels.

parts.label: Front and rear cross tubes (T1, T2)
parts.what: Two 6×2 rectangular tubes running right across the frame through all six plates, bolted to each by angle clips: they hold the two sandwiches at their distance and keep the frame from racking.

parts.label: Power Cube cradle
parts.what: Two 4×4 tubes across between the inner panels, bolted to them through angle clips: the Power Cube’s skids stand on them and are pinned down, so the cube comes off again with four pins and two hoses. Not in OSE’s v25 CAD, which builds its engine into the frame instead; sized here to carry the cube clear of the wheel motors and the shafts.

parts.label: Grade-8 bolts, nuts and washers (F3–F8)
parts.what: The frame is bolted, not welded, so it can be built with a drill and taken apart for repair: 154 half-inch and 170 three-eighths grade-8 bolts, each with its nut and two hardened washers.

parts.label: Wheel motor, front left
parts.what: A low-speed, high-torque hydraulic motor (orbital, gerotor class) driving the front left wheel directly. Oil from its side’s valve turns it; swapping the oil’s way through it (the valve’s other coil) turns it back.
parts.moves: Its output shaft turns with the wheel; the body stays bolted to the motor plate.
parts.drive: The left drive valve (D1 forward / D2 back), its pair in parallel
specs: White RS, Char-Lynn H or Parker TG (to bench-test)

parts.label: Wheel shaft, front left (R6)
parts.what: A 1¼" round shaft from the motor’s coupling out through both bearings to the hub: it carries the wheel’s weight on the bearings and the motor’s torque to the hub.
parts.moves: Turns with the wheel.
parts.drive: The wheel motor, through the coupling

parts.label: Shaft coupling, front left
parts.what: A 2" sleeve joining the motor’s 1" shaft to the 1¼" wheel shaft, so the motor never carries the wheel’s load: the bearings do.
parts.moves: Turns with the shaft.
specs: Ø1" motor shaft to Ø1¼" wheel shaft

parts.label: Flange bearings, front left
parts.what: Two 4-bolt flange bearings, one on the inner panel and one on the outer, holding the shaft at both ends of the sandwich so the wheel’s load is carried across the 120 mm gap.
parts.moves: Their inner races turn with the shaft; the housings are bolted still.

parts.label: Wheel hub, front left (P17, T7, P18)
parts.what: A DIY hub: a 2" DOM tube bored to slip on the shaft and locked to it with a 1/2" cross-bolt, welded to a 9" lug plate of 1/2" steel braced by four gussets. The Bobcat wheel bolts to the plate’s eight studs.
parts.moves: Turns with the shaft.

parts.label: Wheel and tyre, front left
parts.what: A Bobcat skid-steer wheel (P/N 7232567): a 12-16.5 tyre on a 16.5 × 10 rim with eight lug nuts. The CAD draws it 617.5 mm across so it stands on the ground; the real tyre is 851 mm, which would lift the frame by about 116 mm.
parts.moves: Rolls. With no steering, the machine turns by skidding: the left and right pairs driven at different speeds or opposite ways.
parts.drive: Its wheel motor, through shaft and hub

parts.label: Motor hoses, front left
parts.what: The two work lines of the front left motor: one feeds it, the other takes the oil back; which is which depends on the way it is driven. Its partner on the same side is fed in parallel, so both wheels of a side always turn together.
specs: teed to the rear motor’s lines

parts.label: Wheel motor, front right
parts.what: A low-speed, high-torque hydraulic motor (orbital, gerotor class) driving the front right wheel directly. Oil from its side’s valve turns it; swapping the oil’s way through it (the valve’s other coil) turns it back.
parts.moves: Its output shaft turns with the wheel; the body stays bolted to the motor plate.
parts.drive: The right drive valve (D3 forward / D4 back), its pair in parallel
specs: White RS, Char-Lynn H or Parker TG (to bench-test)

parts.label: Wheel shaft, front right (R6)
parts.what: A 1¼" round shaft from the motor’s coupling out through both bearings to the hub: it carries the wheel’s weight on the bearings and the motor’s torque to the hub.
parts.moves: Turns with the wheel.
parts.drive: The wheel motor, through the coupling

parts.label: Shaft coupling, front right
parts.what: A 2" sleeve joining the motor’s 1" shaft to the 1¼" wheel shaft, so the motor never carries the wheel’s load: the bearings do.
parts.moves: Turns with the shaft.
specs: Ø1" motor shaft to Ø1¼" wheel shaft

parts.label: Flange bearings, front right
parts.what: Two 4-bolt flange bearings, one on the inner panel and one on the outer, holding the shaft at both ends of the sandwich so the wheel’s load is carried across the 120 mm gap.
parts.moves: Their inner races turn with the shaft; the housings are bolted still.

parts.label: Power Cube base skids (4×4 tube)
parts.what: Two 4×4 steel tubes front to back under the cube: the “strong structural frame” of 7s that the engine, pump and tanks bolt to, and that takes the forks, the lifting pins or another cube stacked on it.

parts.label: Power Cube posts and top rails (2×2 angle)
parts.what: Four corner posts and four top rails of 1/4" × 2" × 2" angle make the cube’s cage: they guard the engine, carry the fuel tank and give hand-holds to lift it by. OSE’s frame page cuts its members 29", 27" and 24" long.

parts.label: Power Cube quick-attach plate
parts.what: How the cube is coupled to a machine: plates across its back with a 4×8 receiver tube between them, so it slides onto the machine’s mount and is pinned, and comes off again in minutes for the next machine. Several cubes can be strung together for more power.

parts.label: Power Cube lifting eyes
parts.what: Two eyes on the top rails: at about 181 kg the cube is lifted on and off a machine by the loader, a hoist or two people with a bar.

parts.label: Engine mount plate
parts.what: The plate the engine’s base bolts to, itself bolted across the skids: it holds the engine’s shaft exactly in line with the pump’s.

parts.label: Engine crankcase
parts.what: The 28 hp Briggs & Stratton V-twin’s crankcase: crankshaft, camshaft, the oil sump and the governor that holds it at its speed. The crankshaft runs fore and aft: the flywheel at the front, the pump at the back.
parts.moves: The crankshaft inside turns at engine speed.
specs: Briggs & Stratton 28 hp (20.9 kW) V-twin, air-cooled

parts.label: Engine cylinder and head, left
parts.what: One bank of the 90° V-twin: a finned air-cooled cylinder and its overhead-valve head. The flywheel’s fan pushes air through the shroud and over these fins.
parts.moves: Its piston runs up and down inside, twice per two turns of the crank.

parts.label: Engine cylinder and head, right
parts.what: One bank of the 90° V-twin: a finned air-cooled cylinder and its overhead-valve head. The flywheel’s fan pushes air through the shroud and over these fins.
parts.moves: Its piston runs up and down inside, twice per two turns of the crank.

parts.label: Blower housing
parts.what: The shroud over the flywheel, ducting its fan’s air back over both cylinders.

parts.label: Flywheel and fan screen
parts.what: The flywheel at the crank’s front: its weight smooths the twin’s firing, its magnets fire the plugs and charge the battery, its vanes are the cooling fan.
parts.moves: Turns with the crankshaft (shown slowed: really 60 turns a second).

parts.label: Air cleaner
parts.what: The paper element in the V between the cylinders: every litre of air the engine breathes is cleaned here first.

parts.label: Muffler
parts.what: The Briggs & Stratton muffler behind the cylinders, collecting both exhausts into one can and blowing out to the side.

parts.label: Electric starter
parts.what: The 12 V starter whose pinion meshes with the flywheel’s ring gear while the key is held to START.
parts.moves: Spins only while starting.

parts.label: Shaft coupling
parts.what: Not a bought jaw coupling: OSE cut two coupling halves and welded them into one sleeve, keyed and set-screwed to the engine’s shaft, splined onto the pump’s 3/4" shaft.
parts.moves: Turns with the engine (shown slowed).
parts.drive: The crankshaft; it drives the pump

parts.label: Pump mount
parts.what: A plate on the engine plate holding the pump’s SAE-A flange square to the engine, its two bolts on 4.19" centres, so the shafts stay in line.

parts.label: Hydraulic gear pump
parts.what: A fixed-displacement gear pump: two gears mesh and carry oil from the suction port round to the pressure port — about a cubic inch every turn, 15 gallons a minute at engine speed. This flow is everything the machine it is coupled to can do.
parts.moves: Its gears turn with the engine.

parts.label: Hydraulic reservoir (7 gal)
parts.what: The oil tank across the back of the cube, removable for cleaning. The pump draws through a strainer at its bottom; returns come back in at its top, where the oil settles and lets go of its air. Earlier cubes used their tanks as members of the frame.

parts.label: Suction strainer and line
parts.what: A mesh strainer inside the reservoir’s outlet and the wide soft line down to the pump’s inlet: wide so the pump never starves and cavitates.

parts.label: Relief valve
parts.what: Added to the cube in October 2014: a spring-loaded valve that dumps the pump’s flow back to the tank when the pressure reaches its setting, so nothing bursts when a cylinder bottoms out or a wheel stalls.
parts.moves: Its poppet lifts only at its setting.

parts.label: Pressure gauge
parts.what: A liquid-filled gauge on the pressure line, added in April 2015: the operator sees at a glance how hard the cube is working.

parts.label: Oil cooler (six tubes)
parts.what: v15.6’s cooler on the cube’s side: the returning oil runs through six finned tubes before the filter, giving the heat of every relief and orifice to the air.

parts.label: Cooler fan
parts.what: The 12 V fan pulling air through the cooler’s tubes.
parts.moves: Turns while the engine runs (shown slowed).

parts.label: Return filter
parts.what: A spin-on filter on the return line where it enters the reservoir: everything that comes back from the machine passes through it.

parts.label: Filler and breather cap
parts.what: Where the reservoir is filled, and how it breathes as the machine’s cylinders draw oil out and give it back.

parts.label: Quick couplers (pressure and return)
parts.what: The cube’s whole connection to a machine: a pressure coupler and a return coupler on its back. Push the machine’s hoses on and the cube drives it; pull them off and it is free for the next one.

parts.label: Fuel tank (7 gal)
parts.what: The removable petrol tank on top of the cube, over the engine: lift it off to fill it away from the machine.

parts.label: 12 V battery
parts.what: The cube’s own 12 V battery beside the engine: it cranks the starter, runs the cooler fan and the machine’s valves; the flywheel alternator charges it.

parts.label: Control panel
parts.what: On the front corner post: the key switch (off, run, start), the choke and the throttle. The cube is started here and left running; the machine’s valves do the rest.
parts.moves: Key, choke and throttle are worked by hand.

parts.label: Pressure line
parts.what: The hose that brings the machine its power: from the Power Cube’s pressure coupler up behind the cube to the flow valve on its top. Pulled off, with the return line, the cube is free to go to another machine.

parts.label: Electronic flow control valve (EFC)
parts.what: The machine’s throttle, on the Power Cube’s top behind the valves: a proportional valve that sends only the flow the joystick asks for on to the manifold and bypasses the rest back to the cube. Before any spool centres, the firmware ramps it down, so every stop is soft.
parts.moves: Its orifice opens in proportion to the signal.
parts.drive: The Burkert driver in the node box, 0–10 V from the Opta’s A0602
specs: One valve, or two at 6 gpm each (one per side)

parts.label: D03 valve manifold
parts.what: A block with four D03 valve stations side by side, fed in parallel: the pressure gallery (P) and the tank gallery (T) run through it, and every valve takes its oil from the one and gives it back to the other.
specs: left wheels, arms, bucket, right wheels

parts.label: Directional valve, the left wheels (D1/D2)
parts.what: A Parker D1VW 4-way, 3-position solenoid valve for the left wheels. Coil D1 pushes its spool one way (forward), coil D2 the other (back); with neither, springs centre it and the tandem centre locks the work ports, so a raised load stays up.
parts.moves: Its spool slides a few millimetres either way when a coil is switched; the coil’s lamp lights while it is (watch them in the moves).
parts.drive: Two 12 V coils switched by the Opta D1608S’s solid-state outputs

parts.label: Coil D1: the left wheels, forward
parts.what: The solenoid coil that shifts the left valve’s spool to send the left wheels forward. Its lamp here lights while the controller holds it on.
parts.moves: Its plunger pulls the spool over while it is energised.
parts.drive: One solid-state output of the D1608S, 12 V, fused 5 A, with a flyback diode
specs: All coils drop if the controller misses a 10 Hz tick

parts.label: Coil D2: the left wheels, back
parts.what: The solenoid coil that shifts the left valve’s spool to send the left wheels back. Its lamp here lights while the controller holds it on.
parts.moves: Its plunger pulls the spool over while it is energised.
parts.drive: One solid-state output of the D1608S, 12 V, fused 5 A, with a flyback diode
specs: All coils drop if the controller misses a 10 Hz tick

parts.label: Directional valve, the loader arms (D5/D6)
parts.what: A Parker D1VW 4-way, 3-position solenoid valve for the loader arms. Coil D5 pushes its spool one way (up), coil D6 the other (down); with neither, springs centre it and the tandem centre locks the work ports, so a raised load stays up.

parts.drive: Two 12 V coils switched by the Opta D1608S’s solid-state outputs

parts.label: Coil D5: the loader arms, up
parts.what: The solenoid coil that shifts the arms valve’s spool to send the loader arms up. Its lamp here lights while the controller holds it on.

parts.moves: Its plunger pulls the spool over while it is energised.
parts.drive: One solid-state output of the D1608S, 12 V, fused 5 A, with a flyback diode

parts.label: Coil D7: the bucket, curl
